reasoning_summary: Diagnostics chain, Q1 FY27 EPS/revenue beat, steady 12% net margin, low capex-intensity relative to peers. Anchor healthcare position.
Specialty amines producer, Q1 FY27 EPS beat estimate by ~120% on margin recovery after a weak chemicals cycle. Early-cycle turnaround bet in specialty chemicals.
Surfactants/personal-care ingredients exporter with blue-chip client base (Unilever, L'Oreal, Colgate). Reasonable 27x P/E for an export-oriented compounder.
Affordable housing financier, 51%+ net margins, EPS beat, 21.6x P/E. Quality NBFC lending into an underpenetrated segment.
Local search platform under Reliance Retail control, cheapest name in the basket at 11x P/E with 33% EPS beat and consistent ~35-50% net margins from a largely fixed-cost model.
CPaaS/messaging infra, 13.4x P/E despite a Q1 EPS miss - starting small given the miss, watching next quarter closely before adding.
South India diagnostics chain, EPS and revenue beat this quarter, asset-light expansion model. Priced richly (80x P/E) so kept to a standard-size position.
MNC-backed welding/cutting equipment maker, industrial capex proxy, steady ~11-20% operating margins and a dividend payer. Smaller share count due to high per-share price, same rupee weight as peers.
Roads/infra EPC contractor, cheapest quality infra name at 9x P/E with consistent execution track record; high share count reflects low per-share price, not conviction size.
Instant coffee manufacturer/exporter, EPS beat, steady ~9-10% margins, diversified export base (India, Vietnam, Switzerland plants). Defensive consumer-export name for the basket.
MSME secured lending NBFC, ~44-46% net margins, reasonable 22x P/E. Adds financials exposure distinct from housing-finance-focused HOMEFIRST.
Branded footwear, EPS/revenue beat, 12%+ revenue growth this quarter. Consumer brand exposure, position sized modestly given a rich 45x P/E.
Mid-tier IT services/digital transformation, cheap at 13.7x P/E for the sector with an EPS beat this quarter. IT services diversifier.

Cash logistics/ATM services with high recurring-revenue characteristics, ~15x P/E, steady double-digit net margins. Non-discretionary services exposure, low correlation to consumer-discretionary names already in the basket.
Shrimp feed manufacturer/exporter, 20x P/E, consistent ~9-11% margins. Agri-export exposure diversifies away from industrials/financials concentration.

Electronics manufacturing services (EMS), Q1 EPS beat by 27.6% and revenue beat by 16.3% on India electronics manufacturing tailwinds. Priced at a rich 74x P/E, so kept to standard size pending margin durability.
Defense electronics/RF systems maker, benefiting from India defense indigenization push, Q1 revenue more than doubled YoY. Very rich 91x P/E is the key risk - standard-size position, not oversized.
